description: This source file implements analytics event handling for WiFi, including functions for device statistics, web configuration, HAL events, command events, and initialization/deinitialization routines. It defines various event processing functions, string conversion for sub-document types, and manages internal state such as a hash map of station info.

classes.description: Enumeration of web configuration sub-document types.

classes.description: Structure holding analytics data, including station map and usage statistics.

classes.description: Structure representing station information in analytics context.
